==Notes==
*This skill also works with [[spellcasting weapon]]s, not just [[bow]]s and [[spear]]s.
*This skill inflicts the longest bleeding duration amongst all player-useable skills in the game for attribute ranks below 19. 
*Amongst the ranged attacks with an activation time of {{1/2}} second or less, Deft Strike has a short recharge time. This can make the skill somewhat useful for skills that trigger on [[attack]]s or [[attack skill]]s, such as [[Nightmare Weapon]] or [[preparation]]s.

== Trivia ==
* Despite the [[skill icon]] showing the [[Ebon Vanguard]] making a deft strike with his [[sword]], this skill is ranged.
* This generic ranged attack skill is the only one that can be used by player [[character]]s. It is also the only pure attack skill that can be used with a wand or staff. Previously, [[Smite]] was considered an attack skill and worked similarly, but was changed before the release of [[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]].
* In [[w:D&D|Dungeons & Dragons]], Deft Strike is the name of a Rogue attack. That attack, however, can be used with both melee and ranged weapons.
